issues.explanation: The current styles use a centered layout and generic typography. To match the design system shown in the Figma screenshot (left-aligned 'Confirm your details' screen), the ErrorBoundary should use the H4 typography token (28px, 400 weight) and left alignment.

screenLevelIssues.explanation: The text 'One' in the title is White in the Figma design (Node 1:29990) and extraction data. The code incorrectly uses a gray token (`colors.neutral[500]`), causing a visual mismatch.

The Upload Card (Node 1:29992) in Figma has `justifyContent: 'center'` to vertically align its content. The code is missing this property, which may cause content to drift to the top if the card height exceeds the content height.
screenLevelIssues.currentCode:
uploadCard: {
    backgroundColor: FIGMA.colors.cardBackground,
    borderRadius: FIGMA.card.borderRadius,
    width: FIGMA.card.width,
    minHeight: FIGMA.card.height,
    paddingTop: FIGMA.card.paddingTop,
    paddingBottom: FIGMA.card.paddingBottom,
    paddingHorizontal: FIGMA.card.paddingHorizontal,
    position: 'relative',
    overflow: 'visible',
  },
screenLevelIssues.fixedCode:
uploadCard: {
    backgroundColor: FIGMA.colors.cardBackground,
    borderRadius: FIGMA.card.borderRadius,
    width: FIGMA.card.width,
    minHeight: FIGMA.card.height,
    paddingTop: FIGMA.card.paddingTop,
    paddingBottom: FIGMA.card.paddingBottom,
    paddingHorizontal: FIGMA.card.paddingHorizontal,
    justifyContent: 'center', // Fixed: Match Figma vertical alignment
    position: 'relative',
    overflow: 'visible',
  },
